name: Montana Global Health
old_description: Our mission is to passionately assist brand owners like you in achieving your dietary supplement industry goals. Whether you’re launching custom, high-quality supplements for the first time or seeking to reformulate existing products with cutting-edge ingredients, we are dedicated to supporting your journey every step of the way.
about:
Montana Global Health was formed in 2019 as a privately-owned dietary supplement contract manufacturer in Kalispell, Montana. The company was established to serve brand owners seeking custom supplement manufacturing with a focus on quality and accessibility.

The company specializes in multiple delivery formats including capsules, daily dose packs, sachets, stick packs, liquids, powders, and pet supplements. Its capabilities include high-speed encapsulation and state-of-the-art packaging. Specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Montana Global Health serves the dietary supplement and pet supplement industries, working with brand owners of all sizes from startups to large companies. The company emphasizes lower minimum order quantities to accommodate smaller businesses.

The company states its mission is to be the most quality-attractive dietary supplement manufacturer in the Northwestern U.S., differentiating itself through reduced turnaround times, regular order-status communication, sourcing of high-quality raw ingredients, and lower minimums compared to competitors. It adheres to cGMP regulations under FDA 21 CFR Part 111.
